items.name: Migrate EstateStatus to AssetStatus enum
items.description: Remove src/enums/modules/estate/ and replace all usages with src/enums/modules/asset/AssetStatus.enum.ts. The two enums have different values — a mapping is required. Estate-only values (DONE, RETURNED, NORMAL, PENDING_TO_SELL, PENDING_TO_AUCTION) need backend confirmation on their AssetStatus equivalents.
items.evidence: bunx eslint on all touched files — 0 errors. bunx vue-tsc --noEmit — clean. bunx vitest run — 18 files, 238 tests passed. grep -r 'estate/EstateStatus|EstateStatusEnum|TEstateStatus' src/ — no results.
